messages:
claire: Quick design stand. Need final benchmark narrative and two hero visuals for the latency vs cost webinar next week. Main audience: product leaders + infra buyers.

ben: Can we lead with one very simple visual that non-technical folks get in <5s?

dina: Suggestion: single scatter (latency x cost) with three highlighted use cases (chat, search, embedding). Secondary: compact bar chart showing $/1k tokens for each deploy option.

harry: Keep model names generic on hero (Model X/Y/Z) and put exact versions in appendix/methodology. Also add a one-line caption: "Measured on production-like prompts; results vary by prompt length & batching."

design-bot: export ready -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/177777/export.csv

claire: Routing plan: clicks -> 3-field form (company size, infra preference, tokens/day). >500M tokens/day leads to SDR. Others to nurture.

ben: Social hooks: 1) "Same model. Different economics." 2) "Where to run inference? See the tradeoffs."

dina: Accessibility: use shapes + colorblind palette for scatter; tooltips should show P50/P95 and cost delta vs hosted.

harry: Action items: ben -> finalize two social hooks; dina -> chart specs; claire -> landing copy + form; design-bot -> confirm csv access. Deadline: EOD tomorrow.

claire: Thanks 44d drop competitor visuals here if you have them.
